name: identity
command: id -u; uname -srm; printf "firmware="; cfgcmd get InternetGatewayDevice.DeviceInfo.SoftwareVersion; printf "\n"

name: permissions
command: grep -E '^(CapEff|CapBnd):' /proc/$$/status; awk -F: '$3==0 {print $1,$3,$4,$6,$7}' /etc/passwd; ip -o -4 addr show br0 | awk '{print $2,$4}'

name: listeners_and_firewall
command: netstat -lnt 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR<3 || $4 ~ /:(22|23|2222)$/'; iptables -S INPUT; iptables -S service_list; ip6tables -S INPUT
